Subject: Re: Hyperscaler delta hypotheses & next tests

Hi Laura — thanks for the quick demo today. A few notes from our side after chatting with the infra team: 

- Streaming behavior: we saw chunked partial responses, which is good. We need to verify ordering guarantees and whether partial tokens can be re-transmitted on reconnects.
- Tool calling: your example looked promising, but our security team will need to know what the webhook retry semantics are (idempotency, signing headers).
- Structured outputs: we tried the JSON schema enforcement in the demo but observed occasional trailing commas returned by one of the model variants. That caused our parser to fail once.

Next steps we propose: a short technical session with your SRE + our infra (30–45m) to run a focused checklist: 1) streaming disconnect/reconnect test, 2) webhook retry/idempotency scenario, 3) strict JSON schema enforcement test with edge cases. Do you have availability tomorrow morning (PDT) or Friday?

Thanks,
Janelle
Director of Platform
Acorn AI

From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>

Thanks Janelle — really helpful call and clear asks. Looping in Rafael (SRE) and Priyom (solutions) to scope the checklist and own tests. Quick proposals below; Rafael/Priyom please adjust.

Proposed focused checklist (45m):
- Streaming reconnects: simulate 100ms drop, verify token continuity and re-stream semantics, confirm SDK vs raw HTTP behavior.
- Streaming ordering: send interleaved requests to multi-connection client, confirm chunk order and sequence ids.
- Webhook retry semantics: 2xx/5xx/timeout simulation, demonstrate our signed callbacks and idempotency key handling.
- JSON schema enforcement: run a schema that forbids trailing commas and mismatched types; test both our curated model variant and the hyperscaler endpoint to compare fail modes.
- Token cost delta: quick report of token counts across the 3 variants for a short prompt (we can run 20 samples).

Logistics: we can run the session Thu 06/18 09:00–10:00 PDT or Thu 06/18 11:00–11:45 PDT. Rafael, Priyom: which window works? Janelle, which one fits Acorn AI?

I'm attaching an evaluation matrix template and the demo recording for context.

Best,
Laura Bennett

laura@redwood.com

Perfect — Thu 09:00 PDT works for us. Thanks for the clear owners. A couple of clarifications before the session: 

1) For the webhook test please include a case where the webhook endpoint returns a 409 conflict for duplicate delivery (we rely heavily on idempotency).
2) For token counts, can you include both request and response tokens and estimate per-1000-token cost using the hyperscaler public rates (we'll provide our billing rep info if needed).
3) Could you also include a quick note in the runbook about fallback behavior if a preferred model variant is unavailable (we care about graceful degradation).

Looking forward — I'll forward a calendar invite shortly and include two infra engineers from our side (ops@acornai.com).

Thanks,
Janelle
